column1: # L3a pilots: imitation of a better-paid neighbour's theta weight, alone and after
# Rule B (2026-10-29; docs/learning_design.md §5, §8). kappa 0.5, eta 0.2, 20 episodes,
# one mixed cell (mu 0.5, lambda 0.1 / 0.9), common seeding with arms/learning_l2.tsv,
# arms/learning_cov.tsv and arms/learning_payoff.tsv, so each arm pairs run for run with
# its no-learning control and with Rule B at the same coverage:
# What to read (Q2, social): by episode, the theta weight of I and C, P(fail),
# P(fail | theta) and the I - C gap, against the control and against lrn-y50-pay[-q*].
# Imitation alone can only mix the cultural weights (no learned weight leaves
# [lambda_I, lambda_C]); payoff+imitate spreads what Rule B learns through the network.
